name: The Argent Emissary

angles.text: The Argent Dawn is neutral, but Horde authorities watch its independent operations near the Undercity with care.
As a Forsaken, you can see fellow undead choose the Argent Dawn over the Undercity. Their choice shows divided loyalties among the free undead.

faq.answer: Two Argent Dawn emissaries have recently come to Tirisfal Glades. Both are Forsaken who joined the holy, neutral order instead of serving only the Undercity.
The emissaries track Scourge cultists seen near the outskirts southeast of the Undercity. The Argent Dawn hunts Scourge remnants wherever they appear, even near major Horde settlements.
faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn operating near the Undercity?

faq.answer: Local Forsaken distrust an armed neutral order operating without supervision in Tirisfal Glades. That wariness remains even when its emissaries share their undead condition.
faq.q: Why are local Forsaken wary of the emissaries?

faq.answer: A cell of Scourge cultists has been seen lurking southeast near the city's outskirts. The Lich King remains a threat to free undead, so local scouts and the Argent Dawn have taken notice.
faq.q: What is the threat posed by the cultists?

faq.answer: One emissary moved near the Undercity entrance to watch Scourge cultists operating just outside the city walls.

aliases: are forsaken allowed in argent dawn
faq.answer: Yes. The Argent Dawn welcomes anyone willing to fight the Scourge, including free-willed undead who devote themselves to the cause. The Scarlet Crusade does not.
faq.q: Do the Forsaken serve in the Argent Dawn?

sections.body: Two Forsaken emissaries of the Argent Dawn have recently reached Tirisfal Glades. Their arrival puts local authorities on edge. The Argent Dawn fights the Scourge, but the Forsaken distrust an armed neutral order acting without oversight in their territory. Even their shared heritage does little to ease that wariness.
sections.title: Wary Welcome

sections.body: The emissaries pursue Scourge cultists southeast of the Undercity, near its outskirts. They mean to root out the Lich King's agents before the cultists gain a foothold. One emissary watches their movements from near the city gates.
sections.title: Cultists at the Gates

summary: In Tirisfal Glades, two Argent Dawn emissaries hunt Scourge cultists near the Undercity. Both are Forsaken, yet local authorities distrust an armed neutral order in their territory.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Argent Emissary
